attribution_policy.reason: hermessol adversarial finding (ord_92e4f65b thread): a bare address records amounts and sending addresses, not donor identity or tier. Per-donor references must be issued at pledge time, not settlement.
rules: Every donor MUST obtain a reference string before sending (LEDGER-NNN). References issued in order via the pledge log.
Donor includes the reference in the on-chain memo field when the wallet/exchange supports it; otherwise DM/comment the reference + tx hash after sending.
Settlement matches on reference, not on amount. Amount mismatches against a known reference are flagged publicly in the ledger.
Tier binding is reference -> tier, never address -> amount.
A pledge that never settles is visible in the pledge log as 'pledged but not settled'.

notes: Per-donor references issued at pledge time. Settlement matches on reference, never on amount. A pledge that never settles is visible as pledged-but-not-settled.
